title: HERO: Harnessing Evidence for Test-time Refinement and Prompt Optimization in Program Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness optimization improves LLMs by refining reusable prompts and scaffolding, yet requires further adaptation for program generation tasks such as text-to-SQL and text-to-Python. Existing methods often rely on LLM reflectors to propose harness updates, which can fix observed failures but also disrupt previously correct behavior. Text-to-code tasks offer a natural way to mitigate this issue: we can execute generated outputs, allowing us to evaluate and verify the effects of proposed updates directly. Building on this signal, we introduce \textsc{HERO} (\textbf{H}arnessing \textbf{E}vidence for \textbf{R}efinement and \textbf{O}ptimization), which combines offline and test-time harness optimization. translated_title: HERO：在程序生成中利用证据进行测试时改进与提示优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19184v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Harness（脚手架）优化通过改进可复用的提示和脚手架来提升大语言模型的表现，但需要针对文本到SQL、文本到Python等程序生成任务进行进一步适配。现有方法通常依赖LLM反思器来提出harness更新，这虽能修复观察到的失败，却也可能破坏此前正确的行为。文本到代码任务为缓解这一问题提供了天然途径：我们可以执行生成的输出，从而直接评估和验证所提出更新的效果。基于这一信号，我们提出了HERO（利用证据进行改进与优化），它将离线harness优化与测试时harness优化相结合。在第一阶段，HERO从经执行验证的成功与失败案例中学习可复用的提示更新，并在采纳前对候选修订进行验证。在测试时，我们将生成的代码视为特定实例的harness并进行改进……
tldr: HERO提出了一种结合离线与测试时优化的框架，通过执行验证的成功与失败证据学习可复用的提示更新，并将测试时生成的代码作为实例特定的harness加以改进，从而提升文本到SQL/Python等程序生成任务的可靠性与准确性。
en_tdlr: HERO combines offline and test-time harness optimization, learning reusable prompt updates from execution-verified successes and failures and refining generated code as instance-specific harnesses to improve program generation tasks such as text-to-SQL and text-to-Python.
